summary: Run sheets for BW25_0600 (Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd, AP02 aminopyrimidine regioisomer series 02): hinge-site IC50 for 24 reserve compounds and the 16-kinase selectivity sweep at 1 µM on six of them. Accepted 26 January 2026; Avernelwick chose a reserve compound with a narrower off-target fingerprint for its next chemistry round.

sheets.name: Hinge IC50

rows.v: Kinase hinge site IC50, 10-point concentration response, ATP at Km

rows: Out-of-window Hill slopes were reviewed under the study plan and rerun or excluded as appropriate. Replicate measurements and fit dispositions remain in the compound-linked primary-assay run records under {{PRJ0044:lims_id}}, referenced by the Plate acceptance sample-card register; this sheet contains accepted summaries only. A constrained top requires a documented control-supported plateau and reviewer rationale in that fit record; fixing the top alone does not establish acceptance.

sheets.name: Selectivity

rows.v: Kinase selectivity panel: % inhibition at 1 µM, six representative compounds

rows: Readings at or above 50% are flagged for a concentration response before any conclusion. Single-point only.

comments.text: AP02-01430 has one reading above 50%. That is the compound Avernelwick took forward; the fingerprint is narrower than its neighbours, not clean.
comments.author: Ravi Deshmukh
